title: Tsunami (Short Version)
description: On march 11th,  2011 at 2:47 in the afternoon, an earthquake and tsunami struck Japan, and even though it’s been two years since the natural disaster, it is still fresh in the memories of many people. Petty officer Greg House joined a group of servicemembers at fleet activities Sasebo in remembering this tragic event.  Soundbites include Chief Petty Officer Robert Szerlag – Sailor, CFAS and Petty Officer 1st Class Clinton Peterson – Sailor, CFAS.  Produced by Petty Officer 3rd Class Greg House.
keywords: tsunami, servicemembers, earthquake, natural disaster, Greg House, Robert Szerlag, Clinton Peterson, Japan, sailor, CFAS, FLEET ACTIVITIES SASEBO
